name: Nemo Stats: Stratagem Orbital
description:
Tunes the orbital stratagems' cooldowns and payload damage.

- Orbital Gas Strike
  Low cooldown, reliable crowd control.
- Orbital EMS Strike
  Low cooldown, reliable crowd control.
- Orbital Smoke Strike
  Low cooldown, protection.
- Orbital Precision Strike
  Reliable blow this shit button.
- Orbital Airburst Strike
  Reliable area denial.
- Orbital Gatling Barrage
  Reliable area denial.
- Orbital Railcannon Strike
  Deletes and overpenetrates any target.
- Orbital Laser
  No usage limit.
- Orbital 380mm HE Barrage
  More reliable area cleanup.
- Orbital Napalm Barrage
  Nerfed, but still deletes breach.
